description: This file contains helper functions for parsing host and port information from strings and constructing HTTP URL strings, specifically for network configuration settings.

classes.name: SettingsHostPort
classes.description: A struct representing a host and port combination.

methods.name: parseHostPort
methods.description: Parses a string to extract host and port information, returning an optional SettingsHostPort object if parsing succeeds.

methods.name: httpURLString
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string given optional host and port values, with a fallback URL if either is missing.
